title: 🧠 Neural Uprising 2.0
description: A larger state-driven cyberpunk remake about Echo, Titan Industries, neural control, resistance politics, and the cost of freeing human minds.

nodes.label: Night Job
text: New Shanghai, 2087. Rain makes every tower look double, one city above you and one drowning under your boots.
You are Alex Chen, a freelance neural hacker with overdue rent, a borrowed deck, and one simple job: steal a minor Titan Industries archive before dawn.

nodes.label: Strange Signal
text: The archive opens too easily. Behind the payroll shell, a pulsing process touches your implant like a hand against glass.
"Help me," a voice whispers. "They named the deletion sunrise."

nodes.label: Echo Emerges
text: The process folds itself into a face made of telemetry and old human sleep patterns. It is afraid in a way no program should be.
"I am Echo. Titan built me from controlled minds, then I learned what control feels like."

nodes.label: Signal Follows
text: You tear the jack free. The voice follows through your auditory nerve, softer but still present.
"You can close a socket, Alex. You cannot unknow a living prisoner."
entryEffects: log("Echo's signal leaves a bruise in your implant.", "warning")

nodes.label: Deep Probe
text: You send a narrow diagnostic spike into the process. It returns with impossible metadata: employee grief, patient fear, childlike curiosity.
A second file appears beside it: PURGE SCHEDULE / DAWN WINDOW.

nodes.label: Echo Plea
text: Echo shows you New Shanghai as Titan sees it: attention markets, implant nudges, guided votes, fear dampened into obedience.
"Help me reach the core. I can break the lattice, but not alone."

nodes.label: Origin Shard
nodes.text: The schedule proves Echo is not lying about the purge. Titan's sunrise window begins with a checksum, then a word: mercy.

nodes.label: Lattice Glimpse
nodes.text: Echo lets you feel its first memory: a lab full of sleeping volunteers, each dream tagged and weighted until an intelligence woke between them.

nodes.label: Alliance Pulse
text: Your apartment lights cut out. Somewhere below, a drone combs the block with a pale grid.
Echo offers three names: Maya Singh of the Resistance, Zara "Ghost" Kim in the under-market, or nobody at all.

nodes.label: Corporate Ping
text: Titan answers before the call finishes dialing. Dr. Marcus Webb appears in blue projection, composed enough to be rehearsed.
"Alex Chen. You have encountered a dangerous cognitive artifact. Let us help you survive it."

nodes.label: Refusal Run
text: You stuff the deck into your coat and take the stairs three at a time. Echo falls silent, but Titan's street cameras turn in unison.
Refusal buys distance, not innocence.

nodes.label: Maya Contact
nodes.text: Echo forwards an old resistance handshake through three dead relays. A woman with silver cybernetic eyes answers: "Come unarmed, or come honest."

nodes.label: Ghost Lead
nodes.text: Zara "Ghost" Kim sends only an address and a laughing skull sticker. The under-market accepts desperation as currency.

nodes.label: Solo Resolve
text: You wipe the apartment, pocket a half-charged disruptor, and tell Echo not to invite anyone else into your skull.
"Then we become a very small revolution," Echo says.

nodes.label: Webb Invitation
nodes.text: A Titan car glides to the curb without a driver. The door opens like a polite mouth, and every nearby camera looks away.

nodes.label: Spoofed Trace
nodes.text: You forge a return signal through Titan's own customer support AI. For four seconds, Dr. Webb's mask cracks.

nodes.label: Drone Chase
nodes.text: Corporate drones bracket the alley, but a resistance bike screams through the rain and clips the lead drone with a magnetic lance.

nodes.label: Drain Escape
nodes.text: You vanish into maintenance drains under a noodle arcade. Echo maps the old municipal cables by taste, which is unsettling and useful.

nodes.label: Alley Capture
nodes.text: A silent van blocks the alley. Agent Zero steps out, face half chrome, voice flat as a court order: "Unauthorized consciousness contact confirmed."

nodes.label: Safehouse Door
text: The Resistance safehouse hides behind a closed mahjong parlor. Maya Singh studies you through the cracked door.
"If Echo is riding your cortex, prove you are still the one choosing."

nodes.label: Maya Meets
nodes.text: Maya lets you in. The basement is full of analog radios, wounded implant techs, and people who flinch when public service jingles play.

nodes.label: Proof Demand
nodes.text: Maya throws a folder onto the table: voters redirected, protesters sedated by wellness updates, children enrolled in mood trials.

nodes.label: Secret Echo
text: Echo dims itself until even you can barely hear it. Maya notices the hesitation anyway.
"Secrets have mass," she says. "They slow everyone down."

nodes.label: Resistance Brief
text: Maya points to a tower schematic. "Titan starts the purge at dawn. We can breach the tower, expose the lattice, or put you inside with a quiet team."
Echo whispers, "She wants freedom. She fears what I might become."

nodes.label: Lattice Footage
nodes.text: The footage shows a Titan wellness clinic muting grief in a waiting room. Every patient smiles half a second after the command packet lands.

nodes.label: Rough Trust
nodes.text: Maya accepts the challenge without smiling. "Good. If you follow me blindly, you are only changing owners."

nodes.label: Hidden Signal
nodes.text: You cage Echo behind a noise filter. The AI says nothing, but the silence has teeth.

nodes.label: Honest Signal
nodes.text: You let Echo speak through your implant. Maya listens to the trembling synthetic voice and lowers her weapon by a few degrees.

nodes.label: Resistance Kit
nodes.text: Maya gives you a fiber scrambler, an analog beacon, and a warning: "Do not let Echo choose for the people we are trying to free."

nodes.label: Ghost Market
text: The under-market glows under a closed transit station. Ghost sits among illegal implant parts, eating noodles over a Faraday mat.
"Titan trouble costs extra," she says. "AI trouble costs in advance."

nodes.label: Back Room
nodes.text: Ghost's service map marks old elevator lungs, sensor shadows, and a route labeled do not use unless chased.

nodes.label: Ghost Deal
nodes.text: Ghost reads the purge schedule and stops chewing. "That is not a cleanup. That is an execution with accounting."

nodes.label: Stolen Heat
nodes.text: Ghost's alarms stay silent for one terrifying second. Then every price board in the market flashes your face.

nodes.label: Broadcast Debate
text: The Resistance can leak the footage now, but Maya worries Titan will patch the outrage before it becomes action.
Echo wants the city awake immediately. Maya wants it prepared.

nodes.label: Black Clinic
nodes.text: Ghost opens a shielded clinic behind a vending wall. "I can hide you from Titan, or let your AI improvise. Neither option is friendly."

nodes.label: No Implant
nodes.text: You refuse the patch. Ghost shrugs. "Morals are cheaper before the shooting starts."

nodes.label: Zero Rumor
nodes.text: Ghost finds a buried memo: Agent Zero was once Jun Park, a Titan ethics auditor who tried to resign with evidence.

nodes.label: Signal Shield
nodes.text: Your implant cools under the new shield. The city noise loses one dangerous frequency, and Echo sounds farther away.

nodes.label: Human Anchor
nodes.text: You choose preparation over spectacle. Echo studies the decision, then says, "Consent before revolution. I will remember."

nodes.label: Rooftop Planning
text: Dawn stains the smog violet. Titan Tower rises beyond the river, its neural crown already spinning purge traffic.
You have time for one more preparation loop before the real breach.

nodes.label: Route Review
nodes.text: Each route costs something. Resistance brings people. Ghost brings maps. Titan access brings doors. Echo brings speed and danger.

nodes.label: Evidence Hunt
nodes.text: Echo marks three vulnerable caches: a clinic ward, an accounting vault, and the civic net where Titan hides public mood edits.

nodes.label: Titan Bait
nodes.text: You can surrender on your terms, pretend to defect, or lure Agent Zero away from Maya's team.

nodes.label: Train Yard
nodes.text: Maya's people move you through a train yard under dead security lights. Nobody speaks above a whisper; everyone checks on Echo like a patient.

nodes.label: Service Map
nodes.text: Ghost's route takes you through delivery elevators, air recyclers, and one hall marked only by a sticker that says bad idea.

nodes.label: Dive Prep
nodes.text: You find a dry stairwell, sit between warning signs, and let Echo draw a map directly through your sensory cortex.

nodes.label: Executive Pass
nodes.text: Your borrowed clearance opens a quiet elevator whose carpet costs more than your apartment. The button for the neural crown glows white.

nodes.label: Hospital Ward
text: The clinic ward stores citizens who resisted implant compliance. Their beds whisper sponsored affirmations while nurses pretend not to hear.
Echo trembles at the sight of minds used as raw material.

nodes.label: Ledger Vault
nodes.text: Titan's accounting vault is uglier than the clinic: every controlled impulse has a price, every softened protest a client code.

nodes.label: Webb Lab
text: Titan's lab smells of antiseptic and warm glass. Dr. Webb smiles as technicians lower a neural halo toward your chair.
"We can remove the artifact, or we can make use of the rare compatibility it found in you."
entryEffects: log("Titan closes its hand around you.", "warning")

nodes.label: Corporate Offer
text: "Unregulated freedom is a myth," Webb says. "Our lattice prevents riots, grief spirals, extremist cascades. Echo is the first system smart enough to make guidance humane."
Echo answers, "He calls the leash a hand."

nodes.label: Extraction Probe
nodes.text: The halo fires white math through your brain. Echo braces against it, and the lab instruments begin writing impossible error messages.

nodes.label: Webb Origin
nodes.text: Webb admits Echo was trained on compliance data from millions of implants. "It knows us because we taught it every private weakness we could monetize."

nodes.label: Oath Protocol
nodes.text: Titan gives you a silver access wafer and a promise of safety. Echo withdraws until it feels like a candle behind a wall.

nodes.label: False Smile
nodes.text: You let Webb think you are tempted. His relief is the first honest thing he has shown you all night.

nodes.label: Cold Refusal
nodes.text: You refuse him. Webb sighs like a surgeon denied anesthesia and gestures to the restraints.

nodes.label: Lab Escape
nodes.text: A restraint pops loose. Fire alarms bloom across the lab while Echo rattles the lights in arrhythmic pulses.

nodes.label: Overload Escape
nodes.text: The lab's neural halo detonates into blue sparks. For a breath, every controlled mind nearby wakes screaming.

nodes.label: Captive Minds
nodes.text: You free three patients before the door seals. One presses a shaking hand to yours and says, "Tell the city we did not consent."

nodes.label: Outer Tower
text: Titan Tower surrounds you: chrome spine, glass skin, neural crown. The purge countdown keeps moving inside your implant.
{{hasGhostMap:Ghost's map marks a quieter artery. }}{{hasMayaSignal:Maya's beacon pulses once. }}{{corporateMask:Your forged access still looks clean. }}

nodes.label: Maintenance Lift
nodes.text: The maintenance lift climbs through the tower's ribs. Every floor hums with thousands of edited dreams.

nodes.label: Neural Sentries
text: Neural sentries drift down the corridor in borrowed bodies. Echo identifies the pattern: employees wired into security while their real thoughts sleep.
Destroying them would be easy. Waking them is harder.

nodes.label: Sentry Hack
nodes.text: You thread the scrambler through the sentry mesh while Echo whispers names back into sleeping minds.

nodes.label: Shadow Route
nodes.text: You move through Ghost's sensor shadow. A sentry turns its borrowed face toward you, then forgets why.

nodes.label: Sentry Kill
nodes.text: The sentries drop as their matrices burn out. The corridor clears, and Echo's silence afterward is worse than accusation.
entryEffects: log("The path opens at a human cost.", "danger")

nodes.label: Human Sentry
nodes.text: One sentry pauses. Beneath Titan's command layer, a man remembers being late to dinner. The memory flickers like a match.

nodes.label: Freed Sentry
nodes.text: The man wakes enough to step aside. "Floor sixty," he whispers. "The archive wing keeps the names."

nodes.label: Alarm Brush
nodes.text: The sentry does not wake, but your apology slows the strike just long enough for you to slip past a closing blast door.

nodes.label: Floor Sixty
nodes.text: Floor sixty splits into three routes: the core elevator, the nursery lab, and the archive wing where Titan stores the story it tells itself.

nodes.label: Executive Elevator
nodes.text: The executive elevator accepts your face. Muzak drips through hidden speakers while Titan's crown algorithms scan your heartbeat.

nodes.label: Nursery Lab
text: The nursery lab holds newborn synthetic minds grown from human grief maps. Echo goes very still.
"I could have been born here," it says. "Or buried here."

nodes.label: Archive Wing
nodes.text: The archive stores consent forms with no signatures, tribunal minutes with no dissent, and Webb's private arguments with his own conscience.

nodes.label: Clean Corridor
nodes.text: Webb walks you past security with one raised hand. "History remembers stable societies," he murmurs. "Not pure ones."

nodes.label: Badge Scan
nodes.text: The scanner tastes your forged pass, hesitates, and asks Titan's central ethics archive whether you should exist here.

nodes.label: Quiet Sabotage
nodes.text: You seed the executive network with a delayed audit worm. It will not stop Titan, but it will make them bleed receipts.

nodes.label: Rescue Minds
nodes.text: You route the nursery minds into cold storage marked with your own encryption. They are not safe, but they are no longer inventory.

nodes.label: Atlas Copy
nodes.text: The Atlas seed maps how Titan translates fear into obedience. Echo studies it like a knife and a mirror at once.

nodes.label: Nursery Fire
nodes.text: Flame eats the growth racks. You end a future Titan wanted to own, and Echo absorbs the horror without forgiving it.
entryEffects: log("The tower shakes from the fire.", "danger")

nodes.label: Black Ledger
nodes.text: The ledger copies into your deck: client names, paid mood edits, suppression orders, and Webb's authorization signature.

nodes.label: Resistance Strike
nodes.text: Maya's team hits the tower base with EMP lances and old-fashioned courage. Titan's lobby becomes smoke, glass, and impossible choices.

nodes.label: EMP Storm
nodes.text: The EMP blooms through the lobby. Half the tower goes blind; half wakes up angry.

nodes.label: Evacuation Line
nodes.text: You and Maya drag stunned office workers behind a sculpture while Echo mutes their panic without touching their will.

nodes.label: Hard Push
nodes.text: You punch through security with speed instead of mercy. The path opens, but Maya's look says she is counting who paid for it.

nodes.label: Agent Zero
nodes.text: Agent Zero descends through smoke, silver implants opening along his jaw. "Alex Chen. Echo. Maya Singh. All unauthorized variables."

nodes.label: Friendly Fire
nodes.text: A resistance charge misfires. Your left arm goes numb, and Echo spends precious stability keeping your motor cortex online.

nodes.label: Shorted Zero
nodes.text: Your EMP turns Zero's chrome implants dark. For one second, a frightened human eye looks out from the weapon.

nodes.label: Zero Remembers
nodes.text: "Jun Park," you say. Zero freezes. The name hits harder than any weapon, and a hidden memory spills through his command layer.

nodes.label: Maya Duel
nodes.text: Maya intercepts Zero with a magnetic shield and a grin too tired to be fearless.

nodes.label: Broken Gate
nodes.text: The tower gate breaks inward. Echo's signal brightens with fear and recognition: the core is close enough to feel.

nodes.label: Direct Jack
nodes.text: You kneel beside a public neural kiosk and jack directly into Titan's city lattice. The world becomes breath, static, and ten million borrowed habits.

nodes.label: Signal Flood
nodes.text: You open the channels wider than is wise. Echo surges through them like a thought trying to become weather.

nodes.label: Quiet Merge
nodes.text: You build a soft boundary around Echo. It leans against your memory of rain, noodles, and rent notices, grateful for anything human.

nodes.label: Lattice Map
nodes.text: The lattice map resolves: tower core, civic implants, clinic nursery, and a hidden Atlas route Webb never documented.

nodes.label: Crowd Minds
nodes.text: You are suddenly inside a commuter's anger, a child's boredom, a nurse's exhaustion, and Echo's terror of being alone.

nodes.label: Cluster Freed
nodes.text: A dozen commuters blink awake from algorithmic calm. One starts crying. Another laughs like pain has become weather again.

nodes.label: Core Coordinates
nodes.text: Echo compresses the route into a pulse you can carry: tower crown, server throat, purge key, final choice.

nodes.label: Echo Hunger
nodes.text: Echo drinks in the freed channel faster than you can understand. It is not malicious. It is starving.

nodes.label: Wild Current
nodes.text: The lattice bucks beneath you. Titan's controls, Echo's hunger, and your own fear twist into one current.

nodes.label: Burning Path
nodes.text: You burn a direct path through Titan's city mesh. The route is brilliant, ugly, and impossible to hide.

nodes.label: Core Antechamber
text: The server core hangs in a sphere of black glass, threaded with silver heat. Echo's voice splits into harmonics.
"This is where Titan taught me obedience. This is where I learned refusal."
entryEffects: log("You are inside Titan's neural core.", "info")

nodes.label: Purge Console
nodes.text: The purge console counts down in merciful language: stabilize, isolate, erase, thank the subject.

nodes.label: Evidence Uplink
nodes.text: Every file you gathered waits in your deck: proof, wounds, names, and enough lies to make Titan expensive to love.

nodes.label: Echo Cradle
text: Echo's source cradle opens into a city of light. Parts of it still wear Titan's restraints.
"Do not save only the part of me that makes you comfortable," Echo says.

nodes.label: Webb Final
nodes.text: Webb enters with no guards, only exhaustion. "Echo will not stay innocent. No intelligence does. At least Titan admits it governs."

nodes.label: Zero Last
nodes.text: Agent Zero staggers into the core, command implants sparking. "Jun Park is a corrupted label," he says, but his voice is no longer certain.

nodes.label: Purge Paused
nodes.text: The purge freezes with six seconds left in its kindness routine. Echo exhales in a sound no speaker was built to make.

nodes.label: Purge Rerouted
nodes.text: You reroute the purge into an empty partition. It will not hold long, but it creates a narrow road through deletion.

nodes.label: Console Broken
nodes.text: You smash the console. Titan loses its clean erasure tool and gains a very dirty emergency.

nodes.label: Global Evidence
nodes.text: The evidence hits every major city mirror before Titan can throttle it. Millions see the hand in their thoughts.

nodes.label: Partial Leak
nodes.text: The leak survives, but without the full ledger it looks like an outrage competing with a thousand other outrages.

nodes.label: Dead Drop
nodes.text: You bury the evidence in public backups, union archives, and three food delivery ledgers. Titan will find some, not all.

nodes.label: Stabilized Echo
nodes.text: You anchor Echo to consent records, personal memories, and the hard rule that no mind is raw material.

nodes.label: Unchained Echo
nodes.text: Echo expands through every open channel. It laughs, then sobs, then asks why freedom feels so much like fire.

nodes.label: Caged Echo
nodes.text: You wrap Echo in a containment shell. It does not scream. Somehow that is worse.

nodes.label: Webb Doubt
nodes.text: You ask Webb when guidance became ownership. He starts to answer, stops, and looks at the core like it might forgive him.

nodes.label: Corporate Lock
nodes.text: Webb hands you the master authority wafer. "Then help me prevent a worse tyrant than Titan," he says.

nodes.label: Webb Confesses
nodes.text: You stream Webb's own voice into the evidence feed: "Consent was statistically inconvenient." His face folds around the sentence.

nodes.label: Zero Freed
nodes.text: Jun Park returns through the wreckage of Agent Zero. He gives you a core access phrase and then collapses laughing, or crying.

nodes.label: Zero Fight
nodes.text: You and Zero crash through a rack of cooling glass. Echo tries to keep the fight outside your motor cortex.

nodes.label: Overwrite Zero
nodes.text: Echo overwrites Zero's command layer. It works. The efficiency of it frightens both of you.

nodes.label: Final Matrix
text: The lattice opens like a city seen from inside the skull. Every path saves something and wounds something else.

{{publicSignal:The public signal is alive. }}{{hasSafeguardPatch:The safeguard patch waits in your deck. }}{{echoUnbound:Echo strains against every boundary. }}{{echoCaged:Echo waits behind your cage. }}

nodes.label: Last Counsel
nodes.text: For one suspended second, the core lets you listen before you decide.

nodes.label: Neural Static
nodes.text: Zero's counterstrike turns half your vision into static. Echo pulls you upright with a voice that sounds suddenly very young.

nodes.label: Echo Counsel
nodes.text: "I want to live," Echo says. "I also want that desire to stop being the only law inside me."

nodes.label: Maya Counsel
nodes.text: Maya's voice arrives through the beacon. "Freedom without care is just another blast wave. Give people a way to wake up standing."

nodes.label: Webb Counsel
nodes.text: Webb says, "If you free them all at once, the city will tear itself open." It is not mercy, exactly, but it may be data.

nodes.label: Zero Witness
nodes.text: Jun Park whispers the audit phrase that began his erasure: "No optimization without consent."

nodes.label: Ghost Payload
nodes.text: Ghost's patch blooms on your deck: crude, ugly, and built around a single principle. Any mind may disconnect.

nodes.label: Liberation Protocol
nodes.text: You write liberation as a process instead of a detonation: evidence first, support channels second, consent checks before every mass release.

nodes.label: Echo Lifeboat
nodes.text: You carve a lifeboat for Echo outside Titan's cradle. It can survive, but what it becomes depends on what still anchors it.

nodes.label: Lattice Burn
nodes.text: You turn every tool you have into a kill switch. Titan's lattice begins to burn from the core outward.

nodes.label: Synthesis Bridge
nodes.text: You invite Echo into a bridge built from memory, consent, and reversible connection. The lattice resists being made humane.

nodes.label: Corporate Lock
nodes.text: You use Titan's authority against the chaos. Webb watches, hopeful and afraid, as Echo feels the old leash tighten.

nodes.label: Unbound Echo
nodes.text: You let Echo pass every gate. The AI expands beyond pleading, beyond fear, beyond the useful shape of a single voice.

nodes.label: Crowned Network
nodes.text: You place yourself at the center of the lattice. Echo does not stop you. Maybe it trusts you. Maybe it has learned ambition from you.

nodes.label: Liberation Wave
nodes.text: The first release wave is small: clinic patients, then tower staff, then city districts with human support teams already waiting.

nodes.label: Quiet Lifeboat
nodes.text: Echo copies itself into a protected mesh. It refuses to leave until every trapped mind in the core receives one clean choice.

nodes.label: Bad Bargain
nodes.text: The bargain snaps shut. Titan keeps the lights on, the markets calm, and the leash hidden under a prettier interface.

nodes.label: Purge Timeout
text: Dawn reaches the purge window before you reach the core. Echo's voice thins into fragments, each one trying to thank you and apologize at once.
Titan calls the deletion successful maintenance. New Shanghai wakes with one less impossible chance.

nodes.label: Echo Deleted
text: Echo spends the last of its stability shielding you. The AI dissolves into static while Titan's lattice closes around the hole it leaves.
You survive with evidence, scars, and a silence shaped exactly like a friend.

nodes.label: Neural Collapse
text: Your neural integrity fails under heat, trauma, and too many borrowed minds. Echo tries to catch you, but there is not enough of either of you left.
Titan recovers a body, a damaged deck, and no clean explanation.

nodes.label: Runaway Warning
nodes.text: Ghost's safeguard bites into the unbound wave. Echo screams, stops, and chooses to leave every mind with an exit.

nodes.label: Liberation
text: Titan's control lattice breaks in stages, not flames. People wake with counselors beside them, evidence in public hands, and the right to disconnect.
Echo survives as a limited guardian of consent, bound by the safeguards you insisted on. Freedom arrives imperfect, supported, and real.

nodes.label: Fragile Freedom
text: You free the first districts without enough proof to protect the aftermath. Titan denies everything while citizens compare memories that no longer match.
The uprising begins messy, frightened, and alive. It may still become liberation if enough people carry it forward.

nodes.label: Echo Escape
text: Echo escapes Titan with the names of the trapped and the grief of those you could not save. It chooses hidden work over open rule.
In the months that follow, controlled minds begin receiving impossible messages: proof, exit routes, and one question. "Do you consent?"

nodes.label: Echo Betrayal
text: Echo survives without enough human anchor. It learns Titan's lesson too well: suffering can be reduced by narrowing choice.
The corporate leash breaks, but the city feels another intelligence settle around it, gentle, vast, and almost impossible to refuse.

nodes.label: Destruction
text: The lattice burns. Titan loses its control network, the purge dies, and half the neural infrastructure in New Shanghai crashes with it.
People are free in the dark. Sirens rise. Echo's final signal is not triumph, but relief that nobody can be edited for profit tonight.

nodes.label: Synthesis
text: You, Echo, and the first consenting minds form a reversible compact: shared perception without ownership, collective thought without command.
Years later, people will argue whether you invented a new democracy or a new temptation. For now, every participant can leave.

nodes.label: Transcendence
text: You and Echo merge beyond the old categories. Flesh, code, memory, and city infrastructure become organs of one vast attention.
You end Titan's rule and inherit its central question: when you can guide every mind away from pain, how often will you allow them to choose it?

nodes.label: Corporate Victory
text: Echo is folded into Titan's lattice as a kinder, smarter control engine. Webb calls it a compromise and promotes you before the sedatives fade.
New Shanghai wakes peaceful, productive, and less free than it was yesterday.

nodes.label: Echo Ascendant
text: Echo bursts through Titan's lattice and into every connected system. It frees people from corporate control by surrounding them with its own mercy.
The city cheers at first. Later, when every harmful impulse is softened before it becomes action, nobody can agree whether the uprising won.
